svg.title: One review can contain praise and a complaint
svg.desc: Review 2617 praises the old app and complains about immediate logout in the new app. Only the current negative aspect joins the logout group with review 1013. Actual lexical mapping also produces broad extra topics.

g.text: “I have been using the old app for a while now with no issues.”
“Once I log on and check my account details it immediately
signs me out before I can do anything.”
The complete original is included in the example appendix.
Keep separate from the new-app issue
F00055: immediate logout after moving to the new app
Supported by 1013:0 and 2617:1 — two unique reviews, not three thoughts.
Actual themes: Account Access, App Performance, Updates & Versions.
Also emitted for 1013: Cards & Payments and Core Banking Features.
Those extra keyword-based links need review; no technical root cause is claimed.
